tutorSurveys: We were without a smartboard today, but the student's adapted well.
The smartboard went out which disrupted the usual learning enviornment. There was a noticable decline in productivity today.

Lesson did not go well. Students did not have the skills to complete the game using the questions from 8th, 7th, or 6th grade versions of the NJ State exam. I am probably better off just continuing to teach them individual skills.

Students were engaged but the topic was a bit too much for them on this day.
Students probably need a bit more exposure to the topic.
Students had less experience with percents than I was expecting. I created a 6th grade level lesson, but the students needed a 4th or 5th grade level lesson.
I did a bit of a test lesson to see if the student's knew the different parts of speech. They do not. Remembebr to review this after spring break.

Students respond well to simple games and puzzles.
I had to add some extra instruction to help them along. Maybe try to write them down  next time.

Tough class after lunch. Jacilyn and and Jayden more concerned with gossiping than actually learning. Remember to separate them next time.
